description: This Java class implements a device connection service that uses an Infinispan cache for storing device connection data. It extends 'EventBusDeviceConnectionAdapter' and implements 'DeviceConnectionService' and 'HealthCheckProvider', providing methods for starting/stopping cache connection, setting/getting last known gateways for devices, and health checks.

classes.name: RemoteCacheBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: Implements device connection management using Infinispan cache, with health check capabilities and lifecycle control methods.

methods.name: setCacheManager
methods.description: Sets the cache manager used for retrieving a cache; logs the cache manager class.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Sets the specific cache instance serving as device connection store.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes the cache by starting cache manager and obtaining the cache; checks if cache manager is set.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Stops the cache manager and cleans up resources.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Stores the last known gateway ID for a specific device in the cache asynchronously.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway ID for a specific device from the cache asynchronously.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key from tenant and device ID.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache readiness.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health check for cache liveness.

methods.name: checkForCacheAvailability
methods.description: Performs a health check, marking cache as available or not.
